brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the village of al-Mughayyir, located northeast of Ramallah, on Sunday evening, the Shehab Wire reported. Troops deployed to the "Marj Siyaa" area within the village and established a military checkpoint at its main entrance, restricting movement in and out of the community.

The incursion coincided with settler activity in the surrounding region. Settlers began preparatory work to establish a new outpost near Umm Safah, expanding the network of unauthorized Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The dual operation underscores the ongoing security pressures facing Palestinian communities in the Ramallah district.
